repairs.visualReview: Individually inspected native frames 01581 and 01886. Rear swing and grounded bent stance retain the full blue/white body, boots, belt and both gray thigh weapons. The swing web reaches the raised hand. The free glove is folded with visible finger ends and extended thumb; these rear views do not establish palm contact. All 6500 vertices, 8032 triangles, 29 pages and both materials are separately preserved by tests. A black triangular ceiling wedge is visible at upper right in the swing frame; scene/background correctness is not accepted by this suit review and its cause remains unverified. No all-pose contact or background-regression acceptance is claimed.

Individually inspected native frames 01583 and 01888. Swing and subsequent rear movement retain all six visible arms, clawed feet and full torso. The animated free hand has curled fingers and a long authored thumb/claw; extra hands retain open claw silhouettes. The web meets the raised primary hand, partly overlapped by the extra limbs. The preserved 62-node rig contains only two arm/palm chains, with Digit0/2/5 segments per hand, so this review does not accept independent animation or fist closure for the four extra arms. Source hierarchy, weights and all 4286 triangles pass preservation/isolation checks; no extra rig chains were invented.

scope: Pose-only finger repair: ordinary base curl from 60 to 90 degrees; the hash-guarded Arana Gymnast, Batty Brant and Black Cat Venom sources instead use measured per-digit source-relative closure with narrow per-hand overrides. Thumb opposition unchanged; the two original 2099 claw meshes use eased 65-degree distal flexion, others retain 85. Source hierarchy, bind, weights, proportions and materials retained. All suits have full offline regressions; native visual review is representative, not every suit. Native evidence is capped at two images per representative; a crop pair shows one pose, while runs without a crop show the two requested gameplay frames. No exhaustive finger/palm contact or all-catalogue acceptance is claimed.
